description: On the green tabletop, there’s a white AirPods charging case and a white charging cable lying nearby. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up and steady the AirPods case as a right-hand object, while the left hand reaches down to grasp the cable tip and guides it toward the case; both hands bring the connector to the charging port and begin plugging it in, making the case and cable briefly a two-hand object.
